description: This file contains utility functions for handling custom fields in the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions to get field type names, retrieve custom fields for modules, translate field labels, and fetch field data, mainly to support dynamic form generation and data management for custom fields.

methods.name: getCustomFieldTypeName
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name of a custom field type based on its UI type code.

methods.name: getCustomFieldArray
methods.description: Retrieves a key-value array of custom fields for a given module.

methods.name: getCustomFieldTrans
methods.description: Populates a translation array mapping column names to field labels for custom fields.

methods.name: getCustomFieldData
methods.description: Fetches specific custom field data for a given tab, field ID, and data type.

methods.name: getFldTypeandLengthValue
methods.description: Determines the type, length, and decimal values of a custom field based on its label and type data.

methods.name: getCalendarCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves and formats custom fields for calendar views, supporting different modes such as edit and detail view.
